opportunities.name: Demon attack sustain
opportunities.objective: Test demon attack sustain against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Demonic Ascension drains while Swain remains near champions and allows repeated Demonflare casts after two seconds then every eight seconds. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test weaving attacks between Q/E, while Riftmaker and Visage support the drain and Bloodletter improves magic kit packets.
opportunities.requiredState: Maintain nearby champions and collect a realistic recorded soul count.
opportunities.failure: Attack exposure or disengage depletes Demonic Energy.
opportunities.test: Compare attacks, drain healing and Demonflare count in twelve seconds.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R duration is sustained by enemy contact, not automatically infinite after activation.

opportunities.name: Soul health aura siege
opportunities.objective: Test soul health aura siege against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Ravenous Flock grants 15 permanent health per actual soul; Heartsteel adds separately earned health while Visage supports soul heals and R drain. Liandry and close-range Abyssal supply magic pressure; Rylai tests keeping enemies inside the drain so energy does not expire.
opportunities.requiredState: Farm actual E/W souls and reach occasional safe Heartsteel attacks.
opportunities.failure: Percent-health damage and ranged disengage erase the health advantage.
opportunities.test: Record soul count, Heartsteel stacks and R uptime against moving enemies.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Soul count cannot be invented and healing source Stat(12) does not prove every scaling term.

ruledOut.reason: R duration is sustained by enemy contact, not automatically infinite after activation.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: Demon attack sustain
builds.summary: Test demon attack sustain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test demon attack sustain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Demonic Ascension drains while Swain remains near champions and allows repeated Demonflare casts after two seconds then every eight seconds. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test weaving attacks between Q/E, while Riftmaker and Visage support the drain and Bloodletter improves magic kit packets.
testPlan: Required state: Maintain nearby champions and collect a realistic recorded soul count.
Compare attacks, drain healing and Demonflare count in twelve seconds.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Attack exposure or disengage depletes Demonic Energy.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: R duration is sustained by enemy contact, not automatically infinite after activation.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Bloodletter's Curse, Spirit Visage, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Swain frees the demon, which deals [15 / 25 / 35 + (0.04) × AP] magic damage and drains [15 / 30 / 45 + (0.05) × AP + (0.015) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health per second from nearby enemies. His Demonic Energy depletes over time but can be recharged indefinitely by draining enemy Champions and is fully restored on Champion takedowns.

After [2] seconds and every [8] seconds thereafter, Swain can cast Demonflare while transformed, which deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and Slows enemies by [50]%, decaying over [1.5]s.

Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage plus [(60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP) × (0.25)] magic damage per bolt past the first (max [(60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.45) × AP) × (2)] magic damage).

Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal [90 / 130 / 170 / 210 / 250 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage and Root enemies in the area for [1.5] seconds.

Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.

Swain collects Soul Fragments from Vision of Empire, Nevermove, and enemy champion deaths. Soul Fragments restore [characterLevelInterpolation(0.06 → 0.06; raw flags preserved)] maximum Health and permanently grant Swain [15] max Health.

Soul Fragments collected: @f1@
Total Health gained: [(15) × BuffStacks({0dc6979e})]
